issues.problem:
PROBE-C12R-FOLLOWED-LANE (.build-orchestrator/s3f-probes-c12/reqs/Verify/VerifyC12ReqsProbes.swift) fails sweep-first 2/2 (logs/rh-1.log, rh-2.log).

Scenario:
- C (1 MB, zz-b) runs for a prefetch waiter; Y (1 MB, zz-u) runs for a user waiter U.
- v3 moves zz-u onto C's content, so Y's owed visit moves U's interest onto C.
- C then gets a 429 without Retry-After.

Visit-first: before the 429, C's lane is `userInitiated`. The throttle is 0.209572016 s, the interactive first backoff.
Behind the barrier: before the 429, C's lane is `prefetch` and `followedLane(C)` returns it. The throttle is 0.838288067 s, the background backoff. It reads the same right after the 429 and after the drain (VerifyC12ReqsProbes.swift:76, :81).

The origin's throttle is a decision in the class. S3-R15 item 2 asked for exactly this case to be shown with a probe. The draft records R-H as 'not probed'.
issues.fix:
First commit the probe to the serialized barrier suite, in both orders, and show it failing.

Then give `followedLane` the visit's full rule: also count the interests that the owed visits move onto this content. That means the interests, held by other jobs, in ids whose applied entry now maps to `job.transfer`. Use an index from the apply's changed ids to stay O(changed). Alternatively, record that the lane cannot be derived and obtain a ruling.

Update rows I12 and R-H.

issues.area: follow barrier: a place stamp admits on a view with no free slot (residual R-I proven; S3-R15 items 1 and 3; R-SYN-5 'honour Retry-After')
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineDispatch.swift:526-541 (gate: a placeStamps view admits `.start` whatever the live throttle) and :373 (dispatch parks at the stamp's instant); Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineJobs.swift:476-478 (enqueue records the reading's stamp); draft docs/adr-drafts/s3f.md:2005 (R-I 'not probed') and the disposition rows for items 1 and 3 (PROBE-C9-THROTTLE 'Fixed')
issues.problem:
The barrier-end pump admits a place given behind the barrier on the throttle and breaker of the place's stamp. Its comment ('a later throttle ... stops no transfer that runs, so admitting on that view is the visit-first admission') holds only if a slot was free at that instant.

PROBE-C12-PLACE-SLOT (one slot):
- C holds the slot for user waiters A (zz-a) and B (zz-b).
- v3 moves zz-a to N (16 B) while the follow owes C's visit.
- C then gets a 429 with Retry-After 60.

Visit-first: N is queued at the apply behind the busy slot. After the 429 the pump refuses N on the live throttle, A gets `serverUnavailable(retryAfter: 60.0)`, and N never starts.

Behind the barrier (sweep-first, 2/2, VerifyC12CorrectProbes.swift:75 and :82):
- At the barrier's end the state is `(throttled: true, n: downloading)` with `nStarted=true`.
- N's request goes to the origin under the live 60 s throttle, and A is served 16 bytes.
- The visit-first order passes both runs.
issues.fix:
Commit PROBE-C12-PLACE-SLOT (`.build-orchestrator/s3f-probes-c12/correct/Verify/VerifyC12CorrectProbes.swift`) as a barrier test in both LaneDropVisit orders and show it failing first.

Then admit a stamped place on the view at the instant a visit-first pump would have started it, not at its place stamp:
- record each slot freed behind the barrier (an ended transfer, an R1 input applied on arrival) with its world stamp;
- give the k-th stamped place the view at the later of its place stamp and the stamp of the slot it takes (slots already free at the place count at the place's own stamp).

Apply the same to the stamped park's `answeredAt` and `answerEnd`, and to the `.probe` fall-through. Then move R-I from residual to fixed and correct the item-1 and item-3 disposition rows and I14/I18.

issues.area: follow barrier: a 429 whose lane comes from another owed visit does not throttle on arrival (residual R-H proven; S3-R15 item 2)
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineFailures.swift:660-675 (followedLane counts only job.interests) and :366-373 (`.undecided`: no throttle without Retry-After; the comment 'Every id moves: a visit-first engine had cancelled this attempt' is false here); Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineFollow.swift:508-522 (replayThrottle sets the throttle at the drain); draft docs/adr-drafts/s3f.md:2003 (R-H 'not probed') and inventory I12
issues.problem:
PROBE-C12-UNDECIDED-LANE (2/2, sweep-first only):
- D (content Z) downloads for user waiter WA (zz-a); C (content X) downloads for user waiter WB (zz-b).
- v3 maps zz-a to X and zz-b to Y; the follow owes D's visit, then C's.
- C gets a 429 without Retry-After. A user then awaits zz-none, which needs a manifest fetch.

Visit-first: D's visit re-routes WA onto C, so C keeps zz-a on the user lane. The 429 throttles the origin for 0.2096 s, the fetch is refused without a request (manifestRequests 3 -> 3), and the caller gets `serverUnavailable(retryAfter: 0.209572016)`.

Behind the barrier: `followedLane(C)` is nil because D's interest is not counted, so the decision is `.undecided` and `throttle: nil` after the 429. The throttled origin gets a manifest request (3 -> 4) and the caller is answered `.notFound` (VerifyC12CorrectProbes.swift:135, :140, :143).

The lane is derivable without performing the visit. S3-R15 item 2's own rule is 'the interests whose ids the copy still maps to this transfer', and the copy maps zz-a to C's transfer.
issues.fix:
Commit PROBE-C12-UNDECIDED-LANE as a test in both orders and show it failing first.

Compute `followedLane` over every interest whose id the copy maps to the job's content, including interests held by other jobs that still owe a visit and the entries of the passes not yet scanned. Use per-id lookups so it stays C2-bounded. Throttle the origin on arrival; `replayThrottle` then only parks and answers.

If some case truly cannot be derived, record it with this probe as item 2 requires. Correct row I12 and the `.undecided` comment.

issues.area: test defect: `barrierRetriesBehindTheOwedVisitsPlaces` hangs when the first conditions reading arrives after R's 500 (VERIFY gate; S3-R12 2(i))
issues.location: Tests/ZTronAssetSyncTests/Engine/EngineFollowBarrierReplayTests.swift:106-141 (30c2a39): R scripted `[.fail(500), .hold, .stage]` at :121 and requested at :124 with no reading yet; the wait for H downloading at :131; `#require(backoffEnd)` at :141
issues.problem:
The setup leaves the engine idle (watcher stopped, conditions nil). R's user request is dispatched before any reading and fails with a 500, so R is `failed(.at)`.

If the watcher's first reading arrives after that failure, it is an edge (S3-CONC-04). The edge re-queues R's transient failure, R restarts on its `.hold` step and keeps the only slot. The wait for H downloading never holds: a 180 s time-out, then `#require(backoffEnd)` fails at :141.

PROBE-C12-RETRY-SETUP-RACE (gated first reading, 2/2): before the reading R is `failed(.at(1005615401ns))`, after it R is `downloading`, and the test's H wait times out.

At HEAD the committed test failed in 3 of 5 full-bundle runs:
- verify --quick, both orders: `VERIFY: FAIL (1 failed: tests)`;
- the first coverage run, followVisitedFirst, load mean 104.71;
- Sync run 3, sweepFollowsFirst, S3-R12 rule-1 mean 19.87 (min 12.61, max 29.16), which meets S3-R12 2(i).

It passed in Sync runs 1 and 2, in the coverage rerun, and 3/3 isolated in 0.64 s.
issues.fix:
Make the setup independent of when the first reading arrives:
- start the watcher and await `$0.state.conditions != nil` with `EngineRegressionCycle6Tests.driving` before R's request, as the other barrier tests do (for example, request H first and wait for the reading and H downloading); or
- script R's 500 after a `.hold` that is released once a reading exists.

Keep the assertions and the scenario unchanged (G3), then re-run the full Sync bundle under load.
